newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: GPG declines comment on DB talk.
newsitem.headline: GPG declines comment on DB talk.

text.p: Guinness Peat Group Plc's New Zealand Managing Director Tony Gibbs on Friday declined to comment on speculation that the corporate raider was about to take a stake in liquor company DB Group Ltd.
DB's share price has been on the rise over the last month, the stock peaking at NZ$0.95 a share today, its highest point since early July, 1995.
Since the beginning of the month, 22 million DB shares, nearly six percent of the company's capital, have traded.
Brokers said a move by GPG on DB might trigger a takeover by Asia Pacific Breweries -- a joint venture between between Heineken NV and Fraser and Neave Ltd.
DB reports its annual result next month.
GPG shares were two cents stronger at NZ$0.81 on turnover worth $1.25 million. -- Wellington Newsroom (64-4-4734746)
